```{r}
#| echo: false

#| warning: false
#| message: false

pak::pak("jrosell/jrrosell")
pkgload::load_all()
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(jrrosell)
library(fs)
library(ggtext)
library(patchwork)

theme_set_roboto_darkblue()
fs::dir_create(here::here("public", "posts"))
flights <- import_flights()
carrier_lookup <- import_carriers()
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: "hide"
#| warning: false
#| message: false

waffle_data <- flights |>
  filter(near(year, 2025) | near(year, 2024)) |>
  mutate(
    Status = case_when(
      cancelled == 1 ~ "Cancelled",
      arr_delay >= 15 ~ "Delayed",
      TRUE ~ "On Time"
    )
  ) |>
  group_by(year) |>
  count(Status) |>
  mutate(
    Status = factor(Status, levels = c("On Time", "Delayed", "Cancelled")),
    fraction = n / sum(n),
    tiles_round = round(fraction * 100),
    diff_tiles = 100 - sum(tiles_round),
    max_fraction = fraction == max(fraction),
    tiles = if_else(
      diff_tiles > 0 & max_fraction,
      tiles_round + diff_tiles,
      tiles_round
    )
  ) |>
  select(-tiles_round, -diff_tiles, -max_fraction) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate() |>
  print()

p <- waffle_data |>
  group_by(year) |>
  uncount(tiles) |>
  mutate(
    id = row_number(),
    x = (id - 1) %% 10,
    y = (id - 1) %/% 10
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  ggplot(aes(x = x, y = y, fill = Status)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~year) +
  coord_equal() +
  scale_y_reverse() +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "On Time" = "#1b9e77",
      "Delayed" = "#7570b3",
      "Cancelled" = "#d95f02"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Did U.S. flight reliability improve in 2025?",
    subtitle = "No, it didn't. Delays increased from 20% to 22%.",
    x = "",
    y = "",
    fill = "",
    caption = "**Data source:** Reporting Carrier On-Time Performance from transtats.bts.gov\n<br>**Author:** Jordi Rosell (@jrosell) _#30DayChartChallenge_"
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title.position = "panel",
    plot.subtitle.position = "panel",
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 18),
    legend.key.width = unit(16, "pt"),
    legend.key.height = unit(16, "pt"),
    legend.key.spacing.x = unit(16, "pt"),
    plot.title = element_text(
      size = 37,
      margin = margin(t = 15, r = 0, b = 0, l = 20)
    ),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(
      size = 24,
      margin = margin(t = 15, r = 0, b = 20, l = 20)
    ),
    strip.placement = "outside",
    strip.text = element_text(
      size = 30,
      hjust = 0,
      margin = margin(b = 10, l = 20)
    ),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    plot.caption = element_markdown(
      family = "Roboto",
      size = 14,
      color = "gray40",
      lineheight = 2,
      margin = margin(t = 20, r = 20, b = 0, l = 0)
    ),
    plot.margin = margin(0, 8, 8, 0)
  )

ggsave(
  here::here("posts", "1.png"),
  plot = p,
  width = 1024,
  height = 768,
  dpi = 72,
  units = "px"
)
fs::file_copy(
  here::here("posts", "1.png"),
  here::here("public", "posts", "1.png"),
  overwrite = TRUE
)
magick::image_read(here::here("posts", "1.png"))
```
